nodes.name: Dockerfile.api
nodes.summary: Alpine Node 24 image for the API: installs prod deps with pnpm from the trimmed docker-package.json, copies the webpack bundle, migrations bundle and tree-sitter wasm, and runs migrations before starting main.js on port 3000.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses digest-pinned base image and >= version floors for apk packages so CVE fixes are kept without breaking on upstream patch releases.

nodes.name: Dockerfile.frontend
nodes.summary: Slim nginx image serving the built frontend static files as a non-root user, bundling K8s/compose nginx configs and the entrypoint script that selects among them.

nodes.name: nginx-entrypoint.sh
nodes.summary: Container entrypoint that picks the nginx config based on NGINX_ENV and INGRESS_ENABLED, envsubst-ing API service host/port for the no-ingress K8s variant before exec-ing nginx.
